title: S/4HANA Data Migration Consultant
job_description:
Contract- Renewable Position Summary The SAP S/4HANA Advanced Data Migration Expert is responsible for leading and executing enterprise-wide data migration activities during SAP S/4HANA implementation , conversion, or transformation projects. The role covers end-to-end migration strategy, data extraction, cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover activities across multiple business domains including Finance, Procurement, Sales, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, HR, and Master Data. The successful candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP functional consultants, technical teams, and project managers to ensure accurate, secure, and efficient migration of data from legacy systems into SAP S/4HANA platforms. Key Responsibilities Data Migration Strategy & Execution End-to-end SAP S/4HANA data migration activities across multiple business functions and modules. Define migration strategy, scope, approach, timelines, and governance framework. Manage migration activities for master data, transactional data, and historical data. Perform data extraction, profiling, cleansing, transformation, enrichment, validation, and reconciliation. Define and maintain data mapping rules between legacy systems and SAP S/4HANA structures. Ensure data integrity, consistency, and compliance throughout migration cycles. SAP S/4HANA Migration Activities Configure and utilize SAP migration tools such as SAP Migration Cockpit, LTMC, LTMOM, BODS, SLT, Data Services, and ETL solutions . Data Governance & Quality Management Establish data quality standards, migration templates, and governance controls. Collaborate with business users to identify and remediate data quality issues. Ensure compliance with audit, regulatory, and security requirements. Support master data harmonization and standardization initiatives. Develop reconciliation reports and migration validation documentation. Stakeholder & Project Collaboration Work closely with SAP functional consultants, technical teams, business users, and external vendors. Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, and hypercare activities. Provide migration status updates, risk assessments, and issue tracking to project leadership. Deliver knowledge transfer sessions and user guidance related to migration processes and tools. Participate in ERP transformation workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design discussions. Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or related disciplines. Minimum 3 years of experience in SAP data migration projects with at least 2 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or conversions. Strong hands-on experience in enterprise data migration and reconciliation activities. Experience migrating large-scale datasets across multiple SAP functional domains. Proficient in SAP Migration Cockpit, LTMC, LTMOM, SAP Data Services (BODS), LSMW, or ETL/data integration tools. Strong understanding of SAP master data and transactional data structures. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA architecture, Business Partner concept, and data model changes. Experience in data quality management, cleansing, transformation, and governance practices. Familiarity with SAP Activate methodology and Agile project delivery approaches. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Has experience supporting migration activities across modules including: Finance (FICO) Materials Management (MM) Sales & Distribution (SD) Production Planning (PP) Warehouse Management (WM/EWM) Plant Maintenance (PM) Human Capital Management (HCM) Customer and Vendor Master Data Material Master and Business Partner Data Support greenfield, brownfield, and selective data transition projects. Conduct mock loads, trial conversions, dress rehearsals, and production cutover execution. Troubleshoot migration issues and resolve data inconsistencies or system integration errors.
